title: Seminary Review Night
welcome: Join on your phone with the room code.
Answer on your phone, not out loud.
Points get bigger every round, and the finale lets you wager.

rounds.title: Quick Quiz
rounds.intro: Questions on what we've studied, plus Doctrinal Mastery drills.
rules: A question and choices appear on the screen. Pick one on your phone.
The clock starts after the question is read aloud.
A correct answer scores. A faster correct answer scores a little more.

questions.q: Which scripture asks “Who shall stand in his holy place?”
questions.note: Psalm 24:3–4. “He that hath clean hands, and a pure heart.”

questions.q: Maya's friends want her to watch a movie with content she knows isn't right. Which scripture helps her most?
questions.note: Genesis 39:9. Joseph fled temptation and said sin is against God. Isaiah 5:20 and Joshua 24:15 also fit.

questions.q: Ethan made a serious mistake and wonders whether Jesus Christ can forgive him. Which scripture helps him most?
questions.note: Isaiah 1:18. “…they shall be as white as snow.”

questions.q: Ava is anxious about choosing classes and a future career. Which scripture helps her most?
questions.note: Proverbs 3:5–6. Trust in the Lord, and he shall direct thy paths.

questions.q: Caleb feels invisible at school and wonders whether his life has any purpose. Which scripture helps him most?
questions.note: Moses 1:39. God's work and glory is our immortality and eternal life. Abraham 3:22–23 and Genesis 1:26–27 also fit.

questions.q: Liam asks, “Why would anyone need a prophet today?” Which scripture helps most?
questions.note: Amos 3:7. The Lord reveals His secrets to His servants the prophets. Ezekiel 3:16–17 and Isaiah 29:13–14 also fit.

questions.q: Sam asks why Sunday should feel different from the other days of the week. Which scripture helps most?
questions.note: Isaiah 58:13–14. Call the sabbath a delight.

questions.q: Jordan's friend asks why he pays ten percent of his income to the Church. Which scripture helps most?
questions.note: Malachi 3:8–10. The Lord promises to open the windows of heaven.

questions.q: Riley feels like no one understands the pain they carry. Which scripture teaches that the Savior carried our griefs?
Sophie wonders whether God knew her before she was born. Which scripture helps most?
Lucas wonders how the Lord warns His people of danger. Which scripture teaches that a prophet is like a watchman?
Zoe's friend says the Bible is enough and we don't need the Book of Mormon. Which scripture shows the two working together?
Amos 3:7 says the Lord reveals His secrets to:
Isaiah 58:6–7 describes the blessings of:
Malachi 3:8–10 describes the blessings of:
Isaiah 58:13–14 teaches how to treat:
choices: The tenth part of your income

questions.q: In Ezekiel 37:15–17, the two sticks that become one represent:
choices: The Bible and the Book of Mormon

questions.q: Daniel 2:44–45 foretold a kingdom that would:
choices: Be given to the kings of the earth

questions.q: Abraham 2:9–11 promised that Abraham's seed would bear the ministry and Priesthood to:
When Moroni first visited Joseph Smith in 1823, he began by quoting from this prophet:
On April 3, 1836, Elijah appeared to Joseph Smith and Oliver Cowdery in this temple:
In 1835 the Saints in Kirtland bought four Egyptian mummies with papyrus scrolls. Joseph Smith's translation became:
questions.note: The Book of Abraham, in the Pearl of Great Price.

questions.q: In 1828 Martin Harris showed characters from the gold plates to a scholar. This fulfilled a prophecy in:
What is the most important skill in seeking personal revelation?
choices: Learning to recognize the Holy Ghost
questions.note: From the Acquiring Spiritual Knowledge lesson.

questions.q: Elder Ronald A. Rasband said the Spirit most often communicates to us:
questions.note: From the Acquiring Spiritual Knowledge lesson.

questions.q: When you have gospel questions, one way to act in faith is to:
choices: Wait until every question is answered
Stop going to church for a while
Only study with people who agree with you
questions.note: Also: rely on what you already know, and trust in the Lord.

rounds.title: Fake Out
rounds.intro: Write a believable fake ending, then find the real one.
rules: Your set of 3 or 4 gets one clue. Write a fake ending that sounds real.
Everyone else sees the real ending mixed in with the fakes and picks the one they trust.
Pick the real one and score. Fool a classmate with your fake and score every time.

clues.prompt: “Trust in the Lord with all thine heart; and ____”
clues.answer: lean not unto thine own understanding
alt: lean not to thine own understanding
house: call upon his name each morning
seek his counsel in all thy plans

clues.prompt: “In all thy ways acknowledge him, and ____”
clues.answer: he shall direct thy paths
house: he shall guide thee in peace
thou shalt find rest unto thy soul

clues.prompt: “This is my work and my glory, to bring to pass the ____”
clues.answer: immortality and eternal life of man
house: salvation and exaltation of all his children
joy and happiness of all mankind

clues.prompt: “Woe unto them that call evil good, and good evil; that put darkness for ____”
clues.answer: light, and light for darkness
house: day, and day for night
wisdom, and wisdom for folly

clues.prompt: “Who shall stand in his holy place? He that hath ____”
clues.answer: clean hands, and a pure heart
alt: clean hands and a pure heart
house: a humble spirit and a willing mind
a righteous life and a faithful tongue

clues.prompt: “Come now, and let us reason together, saith the Lord: though your sins be as scarlet, ____”
clues.answer: they shall be as white as snow
house: they shall be made clean as water
they shall fade like the morning

clues.prompt: “…choose you this day whom ye will serve… but as for me and my house, ____”
clues.answer: we will serve the Lord
house: we will walk in his ways
we will keep his commandments

clues.prompt: “How then can I do this great wickedness, and ____”
clues.answer: sin against God
house: bring shame upon my master
dishonor my father's house

clues.prompt: “Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and ____”
clues.answer: they shall be one flesh
house: they shall share one home
they shall be joined in covenant

clues.prompt: “The Lord called his people Zion, because they were of ____”
clues.answer: one heart and one mind
house: one family and one home
a willing heart and a humble spirit

clues.prompt: “Surely the Lord God will do nothing, but ____”
clues.answer: he revealeth his secret unto his servants the prophets
alt: he revealeth his secret unto his servants
he revealeth his secret to his prophets
house: he sendeth a warning to his people
he giveth his word to the watchmen

clues.prompt: “Therefore, behold, I will proceed to do a marvellous work among this people, even ____”
clues.answer: a marvellous work and a wonder
house: a great and mighty wonder
a wonder unto all nations

clues.prompt: “Surely he hath borne our griefs, and ____”
clues.answer: carried our sorrows
house: lifted our burdens
taken away our fears

clues.prompt: “Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee, and ____”
clues.answer: I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations
alt: ordained thee a prophet unto the nations
house: I called thee to teach my people
I appointed thee a witness to the world

clues.prompt: “…the God of heaven set up a kingdom, which ____”
clues.answer: shall never be destroyed
house: shall fill all the earth
shall stand in the latter days

clues.prompt: “And he shall turn the heart of the fathers to the children, and ____”
clues.answer: the heart of the children to their fathers
house: the children shall honour their fathers
the fathers shall bless their sons

clues.prompt: “…call the sabbath ____”
clues.answer: a delight
house: a blessing
a day of rest

clues.prompt: “Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse, that there may be meat in mine house, and prove me now herewith, saith the Lord of hosts, if I will not open you ____”
clues.answer: the windows of heaven, and pour you out a blessing
house: the gates of heaven, and send you rain
the treasures of heaven, and fill your barns

clues.prompt: “Son of man, I have made thee ____”
clues.answer: a watchman unto the house of Israel
house: a shepherd unto the house of Judah
a teacher unto all the nations

clues.prompt: “Remember the sabbath day, ____”
clues.answer: to keep it holy
house: to honour the Lord thy God
that thy days may be blessed

rounds.title: Sketch It
rounds.intro: Draw a scripture story and guess your classmates' drawings.
rules: Your set draws the same story on your phone. No words or letters.
Everyone else sees the drawings and guesses which story it is.
Guess right and score. Draw clearly, because you score when classmates guess your story. Pick a favorite drawing for a bonus.

stories.story: Joseph fleeing and leaving his garment behind
A family choosing to serve the Lord together
God creating man in His own image
A husband and wife becoming one
A city of people with one heart and one mind, and no poor among them
Moses with the Ten Commandments on tablets of stone
Two sticks becoming one in a hand
A watchman on a tower warning the people
Scarlet sins becoming white as snow
Elijah appearing in the Kirtland Temple
Martin Harris showing characters from the gold plates to a scholar
The hearts of fathers and children turning toward each other
The windows of heaven opening to pour out blessings
Climbing the hill of the Lord with clean hands

rounds.title: The Final Question
rounds.intro: One hard question. Everything is on the line.
rules: Wager first, anywhere from nothing up to your whole score.
The choices are close, so read carefully.
Right: you win your wager. Wrong: you lose it. Audience members who answer correctly score too.

finals.q: “Though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they be red like crimson, they shall be as ____.”
finals.note: Isaiah 1:18. Both halves promise cleansing through the Savior.

finals.q: “Surely the Lord God will do nothing, but he revealeth his ____ unto his servants the prophets.”
“Thou shalt not take the name of the Lord thy God in vain; for the Lord will not hold him ____ that taketh his name in vain.”
“…and call the sabbath a delight, the holy of the Lord, ____.”
“…open you the windows of heaven, and pour you out a blessing, that there shall not be room enough to ____ it.”
“…take another stick, and write upon it, For ____, the stick of Ephraim, and for all the house of Israel his companions.”
“…the kingdom shall not be left to other ____, but it shall break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms.”
“…choose you this day whom ye will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were on the other side of the ____.”
“He is despised and rejected of men; a man of sorrows, and acquainted with ____.”
Which commandment comes directly after “Thou shalt not take the name of the Lord thy God in vain”?
choices: Remember the sabbath day, to keep it holy
Honour thy father and thy mother
Thou shalt have no other gods before me

finals.q: “Is not this the fast that I have chosen? to loose the bands of wickedness, to undo the heavy burdens, and to let the oppressed go free, and that ye break every ____?”
“Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I ____ thee, and I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations.”
